To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the facets Values and Ideas are important predictors of right-wing authoritarianism, whereas Agreeableness and Tender-Mindedness are important predictors of social dominance orientation.

the facets of Big Five Agreeableness and Big Five Openness to Experience are the best predictors of right-wing authoritarianism, and that the facets of Tender-mindedness and Values are the best predictors for social dominance orientation.

the facet level of the Big-Five model is a better predictor of right-wing authoritarianism than the factor level of the Big Five, and that the facet level is also a better predictor of social dominance orientation than the factor level.

a more detailed analysis of the relation of personality and prejudice.
the relation of personality with right-wing ideology.
the relation between right-wing authoritarianism (RWA) and social dominance orientation (SDO) on one hand and the Big-Five personality factors and facets on the other.

the relation of Big Five personality with right-wing attitudes depends on the specific facet scores and the specific right-wing attitude.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the personality approach is a useful tool in understanding the roots of right-wing authoritarianism as well as of social dominance orientation.
personality traits and values are important in the development of right-wing authoritarianism (RWA) and social dominance orientation (SDO).

personality facets are more important than personality factors in the prediction of right-wing attitudes, and that the facets that are most important for the prediction of RWA are those that are related to social conservatism, and those for the prediction of SDO are related to social dominance.

the facet level of the Big-Five personality model is more informative than its factor level.
facet-level scores are better predictors of RWA and SDO than the Big-Five factor scores.
the Big Five facets are better predictors of RWA and SDO than their higher order factors.
